title: Pentaryn Tool Cursors
description: The mouse pointer on the map shows which scene tool is active, so a player can tell at a glance whether they are about to select, target, measure, place a spell area, drop a pin or draw. Select stays the plain arrow on every layer; Target is a red crosshair, Ruler a gold ruler, a spell-area preview cyan converging chevrons, Notes → Journal a pink pin, any drawing tool a green pencil. Over something clickable the glyph lights up (white with a coloured edge). Only the map's cursor changes; windows, sidebar and HUD keep Foundry's. Purely per-client (one client setting to turn it off). Exposes game.pentaryn.cursors.
